description: The fake catalog cursor keys its row on parameter shape alone, so every parameterless statement (including the runner's SELECT @@SESSION.sql_mode) is answered with lower_case_table_names.
FakeMySQL.__call__ discards every driver connect keyword and no unit test pins host, port, database, user or password for MySQLRunner's own connect call.

The '#' opens a line comment in MySQL but not in SQLite comment explains only the sqlite row; the new mysql row contains no '#', and the parametrize comment calls a different statement text the same statement.
Body comment no longer describes the case it now covers: the mysql row's False comes from the unterminated string failing the tokenizer, not from comment handling.
Comment attributes the outcome to a parse failure, but is_read_shaped is a first-token check over first_sql_keyword and never parses the statement.
The same symbol-led statement names a different statement text, and the leading token is the whole subject of the test.
The row moved from sqlite to mysql while keeping printf('%s', name), a SQLite builtin, and the rewritten comment explains result-column naming the test does not check.
The reworded coverage list drops two tests that still exist in tests/unit/test_sql_runner_event_loop.py, so the enumeration now understates where that coverage lives.
_CatalogCursor dispatches on parameter shape, so three distinct catalog requests share one representable state and the name-every-relation-in-kinds invariant lives only in the docstring.
FakeMySQL.rows is annotated Iterable[Mapping[...]] but __post_init__ rebinds it to a list and fetchmany slices it, so a generator assigned after construction type-checks and fails at slice time.
mysql_runner erases its own type (**kwargs: Any -> Any), so a mistyped constructor keyword fails at runtime and the runner attributes tests touch are unchecked.

One-value dialect parametrizations left behind, with names that no longer describe a comparison (test_nested_block_comment_follows_engine, plus siblings in test_format.py, test_safety_rls.py and test_rule_set_file.py).
The MySQL identifier-folding branch of the relation check has no automated case: every fake answers lower_case_table_names 0 and the live letter-case shape is excluded.
The fake catalog cursor answers purely by parameter shape, so a non-probe parameterless statement and a two-name routine lookup are answered wrongly rather than loudly.
Several dialect axes are now one-element parametrize lists, keeping the machinery and case id without varying anything.

The new MySQL masking unit test builds a real MySQLRunner but every assertion rests on the column labels the fake was scripted with, so it cannot fail if the driver labels these statements differently.
